collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART V (81-100, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A child asks an elder to remember that they found a perfectly ordinary grey pebble today.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) runs up to (friend), an elder, holding out a perfectly ordinary grey pebble. "I found this today," (subject.he/she) says. "Will you remember that I found it? In case I forget?" (friend) looks at the pebble. It is, honestly, a very ordinary pebble.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: "I promise," says (friend) solemnly. "Today, by the stream, you found a grey pebble." (subject) nods, satisfied, and runs off. Several days later (subject.he/she) comes back and asks, "What did I find?" (friend) tells (subject.him/her). (subject) looks deeply impressed. So, a little, is (friend).

b.name: Answer B
b.text: "Why do you want me to remember?" asks (friend). (subject) thinks about it. "Because you remember lots of things. So you can remember mine too." (friend) is quiet for a moment. "Alright," (friend.he/she) says. "Grey pebble. By the stream. I'll keep it safe." (friend.He/She) does.
